notes: Copying now resumes on its own after the master reconnects, and Flatten All and Cancel All reach every account still being copied. If you installed 4.1.3.0, remove BBTC_AddOn_Lite under Tools > Remove NinjaScript Assembly and restart NinjaTrader.
changelog: After the master account reconnects, copying resumes on its own. Some reconnects used to block every copy until you disabled and re-enabled the copier.
A master order skipped because the master is disconnected now shows a warning row and an alert instead of only a log line.
Flatten All and Cancel All now include accounts you unchecked while copying, and the master the copier was still following.
Changing the master or disciple accounts while copying now warns you that the change takes effect after Disable and Enable.
With cross-order on, closing a master position on an instrument that was not converted now flattens the disciples on that instrument.
If you installed 4.1.3.0, NinjaTrader may show two copies. Remove BBTC_AddOn_Lite under Tools > Remove NinjaScript Assembly, keep TradeDisciplePro, and restart NinjaTrader.
